subject: Re: Next steps — burn velocity, budget anchor, and incentive ask
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@ariahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — burn velocity, budget anchor, and incentive ask

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great to see the Aria team map the end-to-end flow. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the concrete next steps and clarify the budget/commitment signal so we can put a concrete proposal together. Quick recap:

- Your initial PoC target is 6M tokens/month for a 3‑month pilot, with a projected ramp to ~20M tokens/month within 6 months if latency and cost meet expectations.
- Primary use case is clinical summarization and triage, latency target 150–200ms p95, and 95% of inference in US-WEST.
- Security and SOC2 evidence requests are with Priya and the security team; Ben will follow up separately.

Requests from our side:
1) Can you confirm the realistic monthly token burn range for months 1, 3, and 6? I attached a one‑page usage projection template to make this quick.
2) What budget range are you working with for the pilot and the post-pilot monthly run rate (ballpark is fine)?
3) You mentioned a founders/friendlies path — can you confirm what sort of committed use incentive would make a multi-month commitment possible? Typical anchors we offer are modest founder credits + tiered committed discounts, but happy to propose a tailored path.

If you can reply to items 1–2 in this thread, we’ll use those numbers to model per 1M token unit economics and present 2 pricing structures: a no-commit month-to-month and a committed 6–12 month discounted path with a founder sweetener.

Attachments: AriaHealth-usage-projection-template.xlsx (spreadsheet to fill for months 1/3/6)

I can jump on a 20min call this week if that’s easier.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127

--
Note: For security evidence and procurement checklist please see the link Priya asked for in the hubspot note.
From: Alex Mercer <alex@ariahealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@ariahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — burn velocity, budget anchor, and incentive ask

Lauren — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below:

1) Burn projection (realistic): month 1: 4–6M tokens; month 3: 12–15M tokens; month 6: 18–22M tokens. The pilot will be limited by our internal QA throughput during month 1.
2) Budget: pilot window budget is roughly $8k–$12k/month. If the pilot converts, we expect to be in the $40k–$55k/month run rate at month 6.
3) On incentives: as a Series A healthcare startup we are sensitive to upfront cash. A founders/friendlies credit of $25k toward the pilot plus a 20% committed discount for a 12‑month committed plan could make the economics work. We can be flexible on the term if there's a clear price floor.

Happy to fill the projection sheet; attaching an exported CSV (quick pass) and we can refine. Also Priya will handle security follow-ups.

Best,
Alex Mercer
CTO, AriaHealth
alex@ariahealth.com

Attachments: aria-quick-proj.csv
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@ariahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — burn velocity, budget anchor, and incentive ask

Alex — perfect, that range is exactly what we need to model options. Two quick notes:

- We can get you a proposal that pairs a $25k founders credit applied to the pilot invoices with a 12‑month committed path that targets $40k/month post-pilot at roughly 20% off list for a reserved slot and additional operational SLAs. That would include predictable burst capacity for the ramp months.
- If you need lower initial cash outlay we can instead do a 6‑month commitment with slightly higher unit price but a similar aggregate discount across forecasted usage.

Action: please fill the attached AriaHealth-usage-projection-template.xlsx with the CSV numbers you sent. I opened a shared sheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-aria-usage-proj — once we have the month-by-month burn we will run unit-econ scenarios and return 2 priced options (month-to-month + committed).

Ben, Marissa — looping you for pricing guardrails and any redlines we should avoid. Also attaching a preliminary SOW draft to speed procurement if they want to move fast.

Thanks — I can book a 20min slot tomorrow afternoon to review.

Regards,
Lauren

Attachments: AriaHealth-usage-projection-template.xlsx, AriaHealth-SOW-draft.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@ariahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — burn velocity, budget anchor, and incentive ask

Alex — Ben here on pricing. Appreciate the transparency on budget and runway realities. A few practical options we can put on the table quickly: 

1) Founders Credit + 12M Commit: $25k credit applied to the pilot invoices; a 12‑month committed contract that sets a price floor at $0.75 per 1k tokens (net) with milestone-driven true-ups if you outpace projections. This gets you close to the 20% off target for the $40k/month band.
2) 6M Commit with Higher Floor: 6‑month commitment with a $0.95 per 1k tokens floor but an additional onboarding credit to reduce the effective pilot cost.
3) Usage Collar: for uncertainty, we can structure a collar — minimum committed monthly tokens + overage pricing at a stepped discount.

I can draft a short quote and push a DocuSign link if you want to lock a pilot credit now and then convert to a commit later. If scheduling works, let's talk this afternoon — Lauren, can you confirm a 3pm PT slot?

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Pricing | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
